title: Parallel coordinates
intent: Compare representative decathletes across four events after normalizing their different units.

ai.create: Create a parallel-coordinates chart from raw decathlon results by folding four ordered events, normalizing each event against the full population, and selecting the final row per country and event before drawing one colored line per country.
ai.maintain: Add or reorder metrics while preserving authored metric direction, last-row country selection, normalized quantitative domains, and stable country-event identity.
